_comment: Customer list for the per-customer news crawler (customer_news.py). customer_id is the McLeod customer id, which is how the Account Health email job joins the output back to accounts. domain is the customer's website (no scheme, no www) - source it from HubSpot's company 'domain' property or maintain by hand. Set enabled false to skip a customer without deleting the row. options.google_news_fallback uses a Google News RSS search for customers whose domains expose no feed.
